statement: Jimmy Essex is a British actor, dancer and musician.
Essex has worked as a backup dancer.
From 2016 to 2018, Essex played the regular role of Adam Donovan on the British soap opera Hollyoaks.
Essex played the lead role in the 2020 play GHBoy and has appeared in other acting projects.
Essex was born in 1984 or 1985.
He is from Harrow, London.
Essex is a singer and actor and has been in the West End.
In 2014, Essex appeared as a male dancer in the video Mr Bowler Presents - Hideaway.
Essex has been a backup dancer for Janet Jackson.

In 2012, Essex appeared in the ninth series of the British television music competition The X Factor, performing as part of the band "MITSOTU" (which stands for "Music Is The Soul Of The Universe") with James Collins and Holly Cooper.
The group "MITSOTU" had previously performed in various London schools in 2011.
The group "MITSOTU" did their first audition for The X Factor in June 2012 in front of an audience of 6000 people.
The group "MITSOTU" went through to the next stage of The X Factor after scoring four "yes" votes.
All three members of "MITSOTU" had "MITSOTU" tattooed on their left arms.
The group "MITSOTU" was unsuccessful in getting to The X Factor's live finals, losing out to rival group MK1.
The band "MITSOTU" continued performing gigs at other venues, such as Kensington Roof Gardens.
In 2017, Essex said that his experience on The X Factor was a fun time in his life and he wouldn't have changed it.
Essex added that he still likes to sing but could not imagine singing in public anymore.
Essex was in the 2016 advertisements for Coca-Cola, which he filmed in Madrid.
In March 2016, it was announced that Essex joined the cast of the British soap opera Hollyoaks as Adam Donovan.
Adam Donovan was introduced with his younger brothers Jesse (Luke Jerdy) and Liam Donovan (Maxim Baldry) as an extension of Grace Black's (Tamara Wall) family.
Essex, Maxim Baldry and Luke Jerdy had auditioned together for Hollyoaks.
Essex' debut as Adam Donovan aired in April 2016.
After his initial appearance in April 2016, Essex's return to Hollyoaks aired on 13 June of that year.
Essex revealed that he felt very nervous when he first started on Hollyoaks.
Luke Jerdy said that Essex was so nervous saying his lines during his first scenes on Hollyoaks that he was shaking.
Essex later said that he became more comfortable working on Hollyoaks.
Luke Jerdy and Tamara Wall have joked that Essex was the "worst" for giggling on set of Hollyoaks and would sometimes have to walk off set because of it.
Essex felt that the Donovan brothers had been received positively by Hollyoaks viewers.
Essex had been a fan of Hollyoaks.
Essex felt nervous meeting some of the Hollyoaks cast as he knew them from watching the show.
Essex enjoyed working with Lisa Maxwell, who plays Tracey Donovan, the Donovan brothers' mother.
Essex found it "bizarre" to work with Lisa Maxwell initially as he used to watch her on television.
Essex ended up getting to know Lisa Maxwell and went to her house.
As his character Adam Donovan was a hairdresser, Essex was given some lessons in the profession to help him with the portrayal.
Adam Donovan's storyline saw a love triangle between Adam, Maxine Minniver (Nikki Sanderson) and Darcy Wilde (Aisling Jarrett-Gavin).
Essex wanted Maxine Minniver and Adam Donovan to get married.
Essex enjoyed working with Aisling Jarrett-Gavin.
Essex revealed that he and Aisling Jarrett-Gavin would spend time together outside of work.
Essex and Aisling Jarrett-Gavin had gone to the same school.
In 2018, Adam Donovan was involved in a storyline where his behaviour got darker.
In 2018, Adam Donovan was involved in a mystery storyline where he was seen being told to shoot someone in a flash forward episode.
Essex enjoyed portraying the villainous side to Adam Donovan's character.
The plot eventually led to Adam Donovan being fatally shot by his father Glenn Donovan (Bob Cryer) in the episode originally airing on 23 May 2018.
Adam Donovan's death shocked and upset Hollyoaks viewers.
In a video on Hollyoaks' YouTube channel, Essex thanked the Hollyoaks team and viewers for supporting him after his departure.
Essex brought in doughnuts on his last day working on Hollyoaks.
Essex described his Hollyoaks experience as "the best two and a half years ever".
Essex said that he was very happy with his exit storyline on Hollyoaks.
Essex liked how his exit storyline made Glenn Donovan's character "so evil".
Adam Donovan's death was longlisted for "Best Exit" at the 2018 Inside Soap Awards.
Nikki Sanderson revealed in 2019 that she still kept in touch with Essex and enjoyed working with him.
In 2020, Essex portrayed Peter in the film A Dark Path.
Essex was part of the cast of the play GHBoy, which was due to be performed in December 2020 at Charing Cross Theatre.
The play GHBoy explored chemsex within the LGBTQ+ male community.
Essex portrayed Robert Finch in GHBoy, a character who is grieving the death of his father whilst dealing with substance abuse and infidelity.
Essex said that Robert Finch's "innocence" and "vulnerability" drew him into the role.
Essex said that he related to Robert Finch's "journey".
Essex was happy to have the "challenge" of theatre.
Essex said that he wanted to tell LGBTQ stories beyond the "coming out thing".
Essex expressed frustration at the lack of support given by the government towards the theatre industry during the COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom.
In 2025, Essex played Felix in the short film Daddy Issues.
Essex had a dog named Stevie as of 2017.
Whilst working on Hollyoaks, Essex would often visit his colleagues Jessica Ellis (Tegan Lomax) and Andrew Hayden-Smith (DS Gavin Armstrong) with Stevie.
Essex said that he and Jessica Ellis were good friends.
Essex said that Jessica Ellis took him under her wing when he started working on Hollyoaks.
Essex commented that he and Jessica Ellis both like watching "rubbish TV" and documentaries.
Essex has described himself as a big "fantasy buff".
Essex is friends with fellow soap opera actor Jonny Labey.
Essex has revealed that he often gets asked if he is related to Joey Essex, which he is not.

In October 2017, Essex worked with his Hollyoaks colleagues Aisling Jarrett-Gavin, Lisa Maxwell and Tamara Wall to raise money for the charity Centrepoint as part of its Sleep Out event in Manchester.
The Centrepoint Sleep Out event included Aisling Jarrett-Gavin and Essex reading a bedtime story.
Essex said in 2017 that his favourite actor is James McAvoy.
Essex is part of the LGBTQ+ community.
Essex began dating musician Charles Simmons in 2013.
Essex revealed in January 2019 that the couple had gotten engaged after Simmons had proposed to him with a diamond ring whilst the pair were on holiday in Sri Lanka.
Essex' former Hollyoaks co-stars congratulated him on the news of his engagement.
Later in 2019, Essex and Simmons were featured in an episode of Trailblazers, an LGBTQ+ video miniseries created by Gay Times and Celebrity Cruises.
In an episode of Trailblazers, Essex and Charles Simmons discussed their love of food.
In 2020, it was reported that Essex and Simmons were married.
